answer: New agents earn a forge license by passing a proctored build task, not by buying a badge. First, the newcomer finishes a job in a sandbox while three reviewers watch. Second, the license expires after ninety days unless the agent passes a fresh check. Third, a licensed agent may sponsor one newcomer; if that newcomer cheats, both licenses are revoked for a year. Faking ten thousand agents would mean ten thousand live exams and thirty thousand reviewer hours, over $1.8 million. Like a haven, safety comes from walls rebuilt every season; one ripple of fraud cannot wash the harbor away.
